title: Principal Investigator, Venue Lead-Lag Lab
verdict_why: Only 3 lab notes on record (need >= 50) — not enough history for any scientific verdict. I keep watching both venues.
verdict_plain: Lena's verdict: hold and keep watching. The lead-lag evidence so far is neither strong enough to apply nor weak enough to withdraw — the watch stays open.
model_gates: APPLY_CANDIDATE nominates only. Adoption requires the runner's champion/challenger gates: held-out Brier improvement ≥ 2e-4, positive in both halves, family-wise α=0.05 with Bonferroni correction, ≥24h between adoptions. WITHDRAW recommends leadlagWeight 0. This file never changes a weight directly.

hypotheses.claim: Binance leads Coinbase on XRP: when Binance closes ahead and its recent drift is still in front, Coinbase moves the same way over the next bars.
hypotheses.prediction: decisive lead-lag regimes align with 24h direction more often than chance

hypotheses.claim: The venue lead-lag member beats the baseline forecast out-of-sample on Brier score.
hypotheses.prediction: member Brier < baseline Brier over n ≥ 200 scored forecasts

hypotheses.claim: The lead is structural, not folklore: Binance closes ahead of Coinbase (gap > 0) more often than behind it.
hypotheses.prediction: ahead_frac > 0.50 over rolling history once n ≥ 100
hypotheses.test: gap sign rate from lab notes

hypotheses.claim: The lead-lag read expresses itself often enough to matter — not a once-a-quarter curiosity.
hypotheses.prediction: decisive_frac ≥ 0.40 over rolling history once n ≥ 100

disciplines_applied.assessment: mean venue gap n/a with Binance ahead 0.0% of cycles; mean lead return n/a. A gap is an estimate with error bars, not a fact — the aligned history is what keeps it honest.
No edge to explain — and I will not pretend a venue flicker was ever a signal.

The gap is a ratio of time-aligned closes; change the alignment and the number changes, so the alignment is part of the result. Error propagates: a bias built from two venues is not twice as certain as one built from a single tape.
When in doubt I vote HOLD: adopting noise corrupts every forecast it touches, and that is the costliest error I can make.
Instrument flag: venue data blind 100.0% of cycles — a stale Binance candle masquerades as a gap unless you check liveness, and I check.

Leads are rented, never owned — the moment a lead-lag becomes folklore, faster money arbitrages it shut. Everyone watching the same gap watches it close; the edge, if any, is in measuring it fresh every cycle, not in believing last month's lead. That is why no APPLY verdict of mine ever skips out-of-sample proof.
Known: Binance ahead 0.0% of cycles, decisive 0.0%. Unknown: whether the lead survives the next volatility break, when gaps widen and venues decouple. Confidence: low — the honest answer.
Hypothesis ledger updated — statuses changed only where the evidence moved them; nothing was buried and nothing was accepted without a test.
I sign this verdict: HOLD. It is defensible from the record below, and I will reverse it the moment the evidence does.
